The Money Move Score

We rank agents the way you'd rank them — if you had the data.

Every partner agent gets a 0–100 score built from public closed-sale records and verified client feedback. No agent can buy a higher score.

Score weights

Local closed volume (24 mo.)25%
Price won vs. list20%
Days to close15%
Deal completion rate15%
Verified client reviews15%
Responsiveness (mystery-shopped)10%

No pay-to-play

Every partner pays the same referral fee. Paying more doesn't move anyone up.

🕵️

Mystery-shopped

We test response time and quality before an agent ever gets a client.

🔁

Re-scored quarterly
